name: Complement of Hall's Maximum Class
definition: The cube complement of the database-owned 299-concept Hall maximum class $C_H\subseteq\{0,1\}^{12}$.
properties: $K$ is a dismantlable maximum class of rank eight. Its cube-completion width lies between one and three because $K$ is dismantlable, its complement is not, and the largest coordinate cube in the rank-three ample complement has dimension three.
